description: Return a list of all equipment Logs for the projects the current user has access to.

id.description: Unique identifier of this equipment log entry.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the equipment was logged for.

managed_equipment_id.description: Identifier of the managed equipment item this log entry records.

onsite.description: Date the equipment arrived on the project site, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

offsite.description: Date the equipment left or is scheduled to leave the project site, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if the equipment is still on site.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this log entry.

login.description: Email address (login) of the user who created this log entry.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this log entry.

formatted_offsite.description: Locale-formatted display string of the offsite date.

formatted_onsite.description: Locale-formatted display string of the onsite date.

responsible_contractor.description: Name of the contractor responsible for the equipment while on the project site.

inspection_date.description: Date the equipment was last inspected, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

induction_checklist_list_id.description: Identifier of the inspection checklist template assigned to this equipment for site induction.

induction_number.description: The number used for equipment induction, unique within the project.

induction_status.description: Indicates whether the equipment has been successfully inspected and cleared to perform work on site.
